values.note: DNR rate table: Beach campground (where the pin sits) $45 with 20/30-amp, $50 with 50-amp, $60 full hook-up; Lake Macatawa campground (Pines and Woodstock loops) $45 with 20/30-amp, $50 with 50-amp. Camper cabins $120. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Holland / Beach campground: full-hookup $60, 50 AMP $50, 20/30 AMP $45; Holland / Lake Macatawa Pines and Woodstock loops: 50 AMP $50, 20/30 AMP $45) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/holland ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/holland (Beach: 'A majority of the sites offer 30-amp electrical service; however, 31 campsites offer full hook-up (50-amp electric, water and sewer)'; Lake Macatawa: 'All campsites have 30- or 50-amp electrical service') + midnrreservations.com resources (Beach: 31 sites Sewer/Water Hookup Yes, 50 Amps; Lake Macatawa: all 211 'Electric Only', 48 with 50 Amps), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Beach campground 98 paved (asphalt) back-in sites just over the dune from Lake Michigan, 31 of them full hook-up; Lake Macatawa campground 211 sites, wooded and sunny, mostly grass, dirt or gravel, back-in, booking-site pad lengths 16-77 ft (one under 23 ft in each loop). Registration for both is at the Lake Macatawa campground, 2175 Ottawa Beach Road.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/holland (Beach 'Number of sites: 98', 'All sites are paved'; Lake Macatawa 'Number of sites: 211', 'The majority of the campsites are located on grass or gravel') + midnrreservations.com resources (309 campsites, Pull Through: No on all; Site Length per site at Lake Macatawa), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sanitation station in the Lake Macatawa campground (two lanes, potable water). Fire pits must be enclosed, covered and raised 6 inches off the pavement; no ground fires.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/holland (both campgrounds: 'Modern campground', 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station', 'Concession or store'; 'There is a sanitation station located in Lake Macatawa Camground. There is potable water available and two lanes') + DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station, water spigots'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/holland (each campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

note: Campground on Lake Michigan with sites behind the dunes in what looks like a large paved parking lot.  --AWH Lake Macatawa campground's Woodstock loop (sites 117-211) is closed for most of the 2027 season while a new toilet and shower building goes in; sites 1-116 stay open (DNR park page, read 2026-10-22). --Claude
summary: Two campgrounds: the pin sits on the Beach campground (98 paved back-in sites behind the Lake Michigan dune, 31 full hook-up), matching the --AWH note; Lake Macatawa has 211 electric-only sites. Confirmed park-wide fees $45 (20/30-amp) to $60 (Beach full hook-up), Lake Macatawa topping at $50 (50-amp), with the Recreation Passport in fees.note; season (manual) unchanged: Lake Macatawa Apr 22 - Oct 21, Beach May 1 - Sep 30. Added 50-amp/water/sewer (Beach FHU sites only), 309 sites, no pull-throughs, modern facilities with store and dump; reservable on midnrreservations.com. Appended a dated note on the Woodstock loop's 2027 closure; --AWH text kept. Not stated: booking window/max stay for this park (left inherited), max rig length.
